_hint.text: Scripts are written and managed in the "Python scripts" tab, not here.

blockedWarnSeconds.label: Warn when a script blocks longer than (seconds)
blockedWarnSeconds.help: All scripts share one process. A script that blocks holds up the others, so the engine logs which state change was being handled when it happened.

maxLogLines.label: Log lines kept in the tab

userPackages.label: Additional packages
userPackages.help: Packages your scripts import, beyond the standard library. A name with optional extras and version: requests, numpy>=1.26, httpx[http2]. Press Enter after each one.

_packagesHint.text: Saving this rebuilds the Python environment: py-controller stops this instance, installs, and starts it again. That takes seconds to minutes; while it runs, the py-controller instance settings show what it is doing, and so does the log.
